subject: Pre-sales technical handoff — multi-team time windows & precall prep
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudhaven.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Pre-sales technical handoff — multi-team time windows & precall prep

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — great context on your inference scale and compliance needs. The next step we'd like to schedule is a technical handoff / architecture deep-dive so our infra and deployment SMEs can align on topology, network requirements, and SLAs.

Proposed slots (duration ~75–90 minutes):
- Tue Oct 13, 9:00–10:30 BST (UTC+1)
- Tue Oct 13, 15:00–16:30 BST
- Wed Oct 14, 08:00–09:30 BST (earlier window for EMEA ops)

Draft agenda attached (pre-sales-agenda-v2.pdf). High-level ask: please confirm preferred slot and any additional internal attendees (security, cloud infra, procurement) so we can include the right Redwoods.

Ben will cover runtime deployment patterns and Karthik will walk through autoscaling/fallback topology. I'll run through goals, success criteria, and next steps (MAL).

If none of those times work, tell me two windows that do and we'll reshuffle.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148
https://redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudhaven.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 18:46:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Pre-sales technical handoff — multi-team time windows & precall prep

Rafael —

Appreciate the fast follow. The agenda looks good. Two notes:
- Our security lead (Nina Patel) and platform lead (Jorge Alvarez) should join for the network/KMS discussion.
- The Tue afternoon slot conflicts with an exec review; can we aim for Wed morning in BST?

Prefer: Wed Oct 14, 08:00–09:30 BST. If you need an earlier or later EMEA slot, let me know. Also, please include any checklist we should complete ahead of time (we have to share a couple of topology diagrams with our security team).

Thanks, Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform | CloudHaven
samira.k@cloudhaven.ai

Thanks for the heads up — Wed 08:00 BST works for us.

Ben / Karthik: can you both make Wed 14 Oct 07:00–08:30 UTC (same as 08:00–09:30 BST)? I want Ben on runtime topology and Karthik on autoscale/quantization profiles & network constraints.

I'll attach a short Network/Security checklist (network-security-checklist.xlsx) and a link to a Drive folder for uploaded diagrams. Please ask Nina/Jorge to drop diagrams in that folder before the call.

I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Rafael
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudhaven.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Pre-sales technical handoff — multi-team time windows & precall prep

Rafael / Samira —

Confirmed: I can join Wed Oct 14, 08:00–09:30 BST. I'll plan a 25–30 minute deep-dive on runtime topologies (single-tenant vs shared pools, KV cache implications) and leave 20 minutes for migration/rollback questions.

Pre-read: https://redwood.app/fit-check/runtime-topologies (short doc).

Samira — if your team wants a short diagram of how Redwood would sit in front of your existing API gateway and VPC, reply-all and I'll sketch one this afternoon and drop it in the Drive folder.

Ben

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Pre-sales technical handoff — multi-team time windows & precall prep

Thanks — Wed works and Nina/Jorge will join. I've uploaded two network diagrams to the Drive link you shared. One ask before we start: can you include a 10-minute bit on audit logs and data retention mapping to our SOC 2 requirements? If not this call, please point us to the right artifact.

Samira
